description: This Java interface defines configuration properties for a MessageMapper within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for property management, condition retrieval, and content type blocklist handling.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: An interface representing configuration properties for MessageMapper, including methods for accessing properties, conditions, and blocklists.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the mapping configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns configuration properties as an unmodifiable map.

methods.name: getPropertiesAsJson
methods.description: Returns configuration properties as a JSON object.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the conditions to check before mapping incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the conditions to check before mapping outgoing messages.

methods.name: findProperty
methods.description: Searches for a specific property and returns it as an Optional String.

methods.name: findProperty
methods.description: A generic method to find a property with type verification and casting.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a required property, throwing an exception if missing.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns a list of content-types that are blocked and not handled by the mapper.
